summary_en: LY Corporation raised its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast by 1.00 yen to 12.00 yen per share, following upward revisions to operating profit and adjusted EPS driven by stronger-than-expected performance in commerce and PayPay operations.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revisions to Consolidated Business Forecasts and Year-End Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
LY Corporation announced on November 5, 2026, that it is raising its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The year-end dividend per share is being increased by 1.00 yen from the previously announced 11.00 yen to 12.00 yen, resulting in a total annual dividend of 12.00 yen per share.

The revision follows upward adjustments to the company's consolidated business performance forecasts. Adjusted EBITDA is now projected at 640.0 billion yen (up from 585.0 billion yen), and adjusted EPS is forecast at 35.0 yen (up from 30.0 yen), driven by stronger-than-expected performance in commerce operations including Askul and LINE MAN CORPORATION, as well as improved profitability in PayPay consolidated operations. These gains are absorbing increased expenses from business expansion including sales promotion and payment processing fees.

The company cited its medium-to-long-term capital allocation policy targeting a cumulative total payout ratio of 70% or more over the five-year period from fiscal 2025 through fiscal 2029. The dividend increase reflects management's commitment to balancing growth investments with shareholder returns while improving capital efficiency and enhancing corporate value.
